verdict.rationale: Clerk's changelog documents Admin Logs, an audit trail of admin actions in the Dashboard, and a now-public GET /v1/logs endpoint for pulling Application Logs events programmatically, so a basic pull-based export path exists. One community user reported being unable to trace who changed a console setting, but this may predate the Admin Logs launch and is only a single report. Missing for 10: tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees for logs, native SIEM streaming or log-drain integrations, clear coverage of authentication events in the audit trail, in-depth first-party docs beyond changelog entries, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can capture tamper-evident audit logs of authentication and admin activity and stream or export them to my SIEM

citations.quote: Audit Dashboard activity with Admin Logs: An audit trail of admin actions across your workspace
The GET /v1/logs endpoint is now public, so you can look up Application Logs events from your own code or an AI agent.
